Clean broad triangulated flat-shaded geometry, one solid colour per material, no grain, dirt, outlines, drawn seams, logos, text, people, floor or surrounding scenery. Believable construction, strong readable silhouette. A narrow cafe coffee counter, walnut and warm ivory base, one compact graphite espresso machine with two readable spouts, several stacked ivory cups beside it. Whole single coherent furniture prop, no steam. Width1.65m height1.2m depth0.65m.
